evidence_set: unchanged V751 decide; all global conflicts insufficient
future_primary: world-cluster paired robustness to order/length versus sensitivity to independently changed truth; no population comparison in this qualification
joint_symbolic: complete shared assignment sufficiency; explicit signed falsity only; any global conflict insufficient; alternative witnesses accepted
local_record: original five-premise interface ceiling, no shared joins

original_method.semantics: Open world; absence unknown; explicit opposite can refute; any conflict insufficient.
original_method.split_design: 60 distinct four-edge development graphs; 120 distinct five-edge evaluation graphs; disjoint entities, templates and graph isomorphism classes

statistical_protocol.primary: macro three-class error averaged per evaluation world
statistical_protocol.promotion: both lower improvements > 0; no added false acceptance or valid rejection; exact correct invariance

primitive_budget_definition.fairness: interface ceiling is not an equal primitive-work budget
primitive_budget_definition.interface: at most five evaluator calls; joint and evidence_set each use one batched call
primitive_budget_definition.predicate_inspections: all input facts/query visits including parse and repeated scans
primitive_budget_definition.primitive_operations: input-record inspections plus evaluator invocations; not an equal computation budget
primitive_budget_definition.python_instruction_count: measured Python VM operations, runtime cache dependent; C builtin internals excluded

token_definition: Unicode words or single non-whitespace punctuation in canonical JSON; protocol tokens, not LLM tokens
